articles.summary: /PRNewswire/ — Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: UCTT), today announced the appointment of Alexander Davern to serve on its Board of Directors, effective September 28, 2026. "Alex brings significant experience across global technology and manufacturing‑focused businesses, along with a strong record of board leadership," said James Xiao, Chief Executive Officer. "His expertise will strengthen our Board's strategic insight as we execute UCT 3.0 and position Ultra Clean for sustained, long-term growth." Mr. Davern has more than 30 years of leadership experience in industrial and technology‑intensive businesses. He spent nearly three decades at National Instruments, serving as Chief Financial Officer, Chief Operating Officer, Chief Executive Officer, and Director, where he helped scale the company across more than 50 countries. Mr. Davern also brings more than 20 years of public‑company board experience across the U.S., Europe, and Canada. He currently serves as Audit Chair of Cirrus
articles.title: Ultra Clean Appoints Alexander Davern to Board of Directors
